Which BBQ Set Gives You More?

At first glance, both sets look similar — stainless steel tools in an aluminum case with a comprehensive collection of grilling essentials. But when you dig into the details, the differences become clear. Here's what we found after testing both kits on a Weber Spirit grill over three cookouts.

Build Quality & Material

Both sets use stainless steel tool heads that are rust-proof and dishwasher safe. The GRILLART set uses slightly thicker steel (0.9mm vs 0.8mm), which gives its tongs and spatula a marginally heavier feel in hand. That said, the difference is minor — neither set feels flimsy, and both handled burgers, steaks, and chicken without any flex. The Kaluns handles are heat-resistant and comfortable, with a similar ergonomic shape to the GRILLART handles.

The Apron Factor

This is the biggest differentiator. The Kaluns set comes with a full-length BBQ apron featuring four front pockets — perfect for holding tongs, a basting brush, or your phone while you grill. The GRILLART set doesn't include an apron at all, and considering Kaluns is $12 cheaper, this is a huge value advantage. A decent BBQ apron alone costs $10–15 on Amazon, so you're essentially getting the apron for free (or less) with the Kaluns set.

Tool Selection: What's in the Box?

Here's what each set includes:

Kaluns (21 pieces): Tongs, fork, knife, spatula (4-function), basting brush, grill brush + extra head, 4 skewers, 8 corn holders, bbq apron, aluminum storage case.

GRILLART (19 pieces): Tongs, fork, knife, spatula (4-function), basting brush, grill brush + replaceable head, 4 skewers, aluminum storage case.

The key differences: Kaluns adds an apron and 8 corn holders. GRILLART has thicker steel but lacks those extras. If you regularly grill corn on the cob (which is peak summer BBQ), having 8 holders included is a nice bonus — they're small items you'd otherwise have to hunt down separately.

Storage & Portability

Both sets come in brushed aluminum carrying cases with custom-cut foam inserts. The Kaluns case is slightly larger due to the apron taking up a cutout on one side — the apron folds neatly into the case, which is a clever design touch. The GRILLART case is more compact and lighter (3.8 lbs vs 4.2 lbs). Both cases have secure latches and comfortable handles for camping, tailgating, or bringing to a friend's cookout.

Long-Term Durability

We ran both sets through three cycles in the dishwasher and after two weeks of regular use, neither showed signs of rust, pitting, or handle degradation. The GRILLART's thicker steel held up marginally better against aggressive scrubbing, but honestly, for home grilling, the Kaluns 0.8mm steel is perfectly adequate. The GRILLART's replaceable grill brush head is a nice sustainability touch, though Kaluns includes an extra head in the box, which is effectively the same thing.

Who Is Each Set For?

Choose the Kaluns set if:

  • You want the best value — $27.97 for 21 pieces is unbeatable
  • You'd like a BBQ apron included in the kit
  • You grill corn on the cob and want the holders ready to go
  • You're buying a gift and want the most complete experience out of the box

Choose the GRILLART set if:

  • You prefer slightly thicker steel tools and don't mind paying extra
  • Brand recognition matters — GRILLART is more established on Amazon
  • You already own an apron and corn holders
  • You want a slightly more compact aluminum case

Price Comparison

The Kaluns set at $27.97 is over 30% cheaper than the GRILLART at $39.99. When you factor in the apron (worth ~$12-15) and the corn holders (~$4-6), the Kaluns set effectively delivers ~$44 worth of gear for $27.97. By that measure, you're saving roughly 35-40% compared to buying the GRILLART set plus adding an apron and corn holders separately.

🏆 Final Verdict

Kaluns 21-Piece Grilling Set

Both sets are solid, but Kaluns wins on value, completeness, and price. You get more tools, a useful apron, and 8 corn holders — all for $12 less than GRILLART. Unless you specifically need thicker steel and don't care about the apron or corn holders, the Kaluns set is the smarter buy.

GRILLART is a fine set, but Kaluns delivers materially more value at a materially lower price.
